title: Palace: PH readies evacuation plans for Filipinos amid EU unrest

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government is preparing possible evacuations for Filipinos affected by protests in at least four European countries, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Monday. Protests have taken place in France, Italy, Portugal and Belgium, driven by student movements, the high cost of living, housing crises, and anti-government grievances. READ: LOOK: Fires,
